input: Learn to read a topographic hiking map

gold.taskTitle: Learn to Read a Topographic Hiking Map
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to develop the skill of reading and interpreting topographic maps for hiking purposes.

questions.title: Have you ever used a topographic map before?
questions.description: Understand the user's current experience level with topographic or any other maps.

questions.title: Do you have a specific hike or trail in mind?
questions.description: Determine whether the user is learning for a concrete upcoming trip or as a general skill.

questions.title: What terrain type will you mostly be hiking in?
questions.description: Identify whether the user will face mountains, forests, deserts, or mixed terrain, as this shapes which map features matter most.

questions.title: Will you use paper maps, a digital app, or both?
questions.description: Clarify the medium so the learning plan can focus on the right tools and interfaces.

questions.title: Do you already own a compass for map navigation?
questions.description: Find out if compass-and-map skills need to be included or if the focus stays on map reading alone.

questions.title: How soon do you need this skill ready to use?
questions.description: Establish a timeline or deadline to pace the learning plan appropriately.

questions.title: Will you be hiking solo or navigating for a group?
questions.description: Understand the stakes and responsibility level to calibrate how deep the skill needs to go.
